The '''Office of the Auditor-General''' was a department of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] led by the [[Auditor-General]] and [[Assistant Auditor-General]]s. [[Dagmar Vozda]] and [[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla]] were both members of the Office of the Auditor-General. The Office of the Auditor-General oversaw two offices, the [[Detached Duty Office]], and the [[Corporate Security Liaison Office]]. The office served to observe and root out corruption and inefficiency throughout the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. It also coordinated intelligence from various sources, including industrial spies, informers, and paid sympathizers embedded throughout the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
